constraints.name: like_transactions_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'purchase'::text) AND (delta = 10) AND (payment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (like_id IS NULL) AND (operation_id IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'sent_like'::text) AND (delta = '-1'::integer) AND (like_id IS NOT NULL) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (operation_id IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'refund'::text) AND (delta < 0) AND (payment_id IS NOT NULL) AND (like_id IS NULL) AND (operation_id IS NOT NULL)) OR ((kind = 'admin_adjustment'::text) AND (payment_id IS NULL) AND (like_id IS NULL) AND (operation_id IS NOT NULL))))
